/**
* PDSH-025 / SPEC 0206: deterministic context compaction before the model.
* The estimator only decides the trigger; summaries are derived from the
* dropped messages themselves, never from a model or provider.
*/
const COMPACTION_STRATEGY_VERSION = "harness-compaction-v1";
const COMPACTION_KEEP_RECENT_DEFAULT = 4;
const COMPACTION_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS_DEFAULT = 512;
/** Fixed heuristic (~4 chars per token); decides the trigger only. */
function estimateContextTokens(messages) {
	let tokens = 0;
	for (const message of messages) {
		tokens += Math.ceil(message.content.length / 4);
	};
	return tokens;
};
function positiveInt(value, fallback) {
	return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= 1 ? value : fallback;
}
function compactConversation(messages, options) {
	if (!Number.isSafeInteger(options.maxInputTokens) || options.maxInputTokens < 1) {
		throw new Error("compaction requires maxInputTokens >= 1");
	};
	const inputTokens = estimateContextTokens(messages);
	if (inputTokens <= options.maxInputTokens || messages.length < 2) {
		return {
			compacted: false,
			strategyVersion: COMPACTION_STRATEGY_VERSION,
			inputTokens,
			keptMessages: messages.length,
			droppedMessages: 0,
			throughSequence: null,
			sourceDigest: null,
			summary: null,
			messages: messages.map((message) => ({ ...message }))
		};
	};
	const keepRecent = positiveInt(options.keepRecentMessages ?? COMPACTION_KEEP_RECENT_DEFAULT, COMPACTION_KEEP_RECENT_DEFAULT);
	const summaryMaxChars = positiveInt(options.summaryMaxChars ?? COMPACTION_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS_DEFAULT, COMPACTION_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS_DEFAULT);
	const keepCount = Math.min(keepRecent, messages.length - 1);
	const dropped = messages.slice(0, messages.length - keepCount);
	const kept = messages.slice(messages.length - keepCount);
	const lastDropped = dropped[dropped.length - 1];
	const sourceDigest = (0,__vite_ssr_import_0__.createHash)("sha256").update((0,__vite_ssr_import_1__.canonicalizeJson)(dropped.map(({ sequence, role, content }) => ({
		sequence,
		role,
		content
	})))).digest("hex");
	const excerpts = dropped.map((message) => `${message.role}:${message.content.slice(0, 60)}`).join(" | ");
	const full = `contexto compactado (${COMPACTION_STRATEGY_VERSION}): ${dropped.length} mensagem(ns) removida(s); digest ${sourceDigest.slice(0, 16)}; ${excerpts}`;
	const summary = full.length > summaryMaxChars ? `${full.slice(0, summaryMaxChars - 1)}…` : full;
	return {
		compacted: true,
		strategyVersion: COMPACTION_STRATEGY_VERSION,
		inputTokens,
		keptMessages: kept.length,
		droppedMessages: dropped.length,
		throughSequence: lastDropped.sequence,
		sourceDigest,
		summary,
		messages: [{
			sequence: lastDropped.sequence,
			role: "system",
			content: `[contexto compactado] ${summary}`
		}, ...kept.map((message) => ({ ...message }))]
	};
};
function createCompactionControl(options) {
	return {
		name: "control.context-compaction",
		kind: "control",
		apply(ctx) {
			ctx.on("model/before-call", async (call, next) => {
				const messages = call.request.messages.map((message, index) => ({
					sequence: index + 1,
					role: message.role,
					content: message.content
				}));
				const result = compactConversation(messages, options);
				if (!result.compacted) return next();
				if (options.onCompacted) {
					try {
						await options.onCompacted(result);
					} catch {
						return (0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.stop)("INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE", "Context compaction could not be recorded; the model call was not started.");
					}
				};
				// I6: the pipeline logs and sends the request after every control
				// adjusted it, so the compacted view is what leaves this point.
				;
				call.request.messages = result.messages.map(({ role, content }) => ({
					role,
					content
				}));
				return next();
			});
		}
	};
};
/** Appends the auditable `context/compacted` session event (PDSH-021). */
function createSessionCompactionRecorder(options) {
	const newEventId = options.eventId ?? __vite_ssr_import_0__.randomUUID;
	const clock = options.clock ?? (() => new Date());
	return async (result) => {
		if (!result.compacted || result.summary === null || result.sourceDigest === null || result.throughSequence === null) {
			return;
		};
		await options.store.append({
			tenantId: options.tenantId,
			sessionId: options.sessionId,
			formatVersion: 1,
			eventId: newEventId(),
			timestamp: clock().toISOString(),
			correlationId: options.correlationId,
			traceId: options.traceId,
			type: "context/compacted",
			payload: {
				throughSequence: result.throughSequence,
				summary: result.summary,
				sourceDigest: result.sourceDigest,
				strategyVersion: result.strategyVersion
			}
		});
	};
}
